mapper.select: select user_name,login_name,gender,phone,email, remark,active_status status, state from bp_user where is_deleted = 0
select id from bp_user where is_deleted = 0 and binary login_name = #{userName}
select distinct role_id from bp_user_role where is_deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId}
select distinct dept_id from bp_user_dept where is_deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId}
select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.login_name from bp_user u join bp_user_role r on u.user_id = r.user_id and r.is_deleted = 0 where u.is_deleted = 0 and r.role_id = #{roleId}
